title: Power of Heroes
summary: Given an array nums representing heroes' strengths, calculate the sum of the squared maximum and minimum strength for every non-empty subset of heroes.
statement: Given an array nums representing heroes' strengths, calculate the sum of the squared maximum and minimum strength for every non-empty subset of heroes. The result is given modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: For every nonempty index subset, its power is maximum_strength squared times minimum_strength.
Sum the powers of all subsets, treating equal-valued heroes at different indices as distinct choices.
hints: Sort strengths and treat each value as the maximum of newly counted subsets.
The singleton contributes maximum cubed; earlier values summarize possible minimum contributions.
Add maximum² times (maximum+prefix), then update prefix as 2*prefix+maximum.
Every earlier subset either excludes or includes the new maximum; grouping by unique final maximum counts every nonempty index subset exactly once.
editorial: Every earlier subset either excludes or includes the new maximum; grouping by unique final maximum counts every nonempty index subset exactly once.

tests.explanation: The seven nonempty subsets have powers summing to 141.
Every one of the seven nonempty index subsets has power one.
